ValidationRule.description: A vote changes only while voting is open, unless the user holds Manage Corporate Hub (R-BV1).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(ISCHANGED(Vote__c), AND(ISNEW(), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Vote__c))))), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Motion__r.Status__c, 'Voting Open')), NOT($Permission.Corporate_Hub_Manage))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Voting on this motion is closed.
